settings.form_lead: Complete the form to sign up

settings.question: Do I need to provide business documents to apply?
settings.answer: Yes. You'll need your EIN (Employer Identification Number) and your line of business. If your purchases are tax exempt, you can also share your tax exemption certificate. It's optional.

settings.question: Is there a minimum order value?
settings.answer: No. Order as much or as little as your project needs.

settings.question: What discounts do Trade Program members receive?
settings.answer: Members get 20% off. During site-wide sales, that rises to 25%.

settings.question: Can I get samples or spec sheets?
settings.answer: Yes. Get in touch with the products you're considering and we'll send them over.

settings.question: What's your returns policy for trade orders?
settings.answer: Trade orders follow the same returns policy as every other order. You'll find the full details on our returns page.

settings.question: Do you ship outside the US?
settings.answer: Yes. Shipping costs and delivery times depend on your destination and are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Does the Trade Program include design support?
settings.answer: Yes. Our design team can help with product selection and specification for your project. Reach out once your account is approved.

settings.question: Can I use trade pricing for personal projects?
settings.answer: Yes. Trade pricing applies to any order placed from an approved account.
